Contact lens exams & fittings

Contact lens exams in Clear Lake, from the doctor who measures your eyes

A contact lens exam here in Clear Lake is a fitting, not a handoff. We fit every kind of eye: first-time wearers, astigmatism, presbyopia, and prescriptions that ordinary soft lenses miss, so you see clearly and stay comfortable through the whole day. And because Eye Trends is a full-service one-stop optometry practice, the same visit that fits your contacts also covers your comprehensive and medical eye exams and your designer eyewear, all under one roof with Dr. Jerry Hyder, OD.

Book an Eye Exam Call (281) 488-0066

Find the right fit for your eyes

Five ways we fit contacts

Every one ends the same way: with a fitting in the chair, never a purchase. Find the one that matches what you need and it will take you to a page that explains the fit in full.

Same-Day Contacts Walk out wearing trial lenses today. Come in with a question about contacts and leave with trial lenses on your eyes the same day, for the common prescriptions we keep on hand. Learn more
Specialty & Hard-to-Fit Contacts For eyes standard lenses miss. Toric, gas permeable, and multifocal fittings for the harder prescriptions that ordinary soft lenses can't quite handle. Learn more
Toric Contacts Clear, stable vision with astigmatism. Toric lenses that hold their orientation and stay put through the day, so astigmatism doesn't blur back in by afternoon. Learn more
Gas Permeable (GP) Contacts Crisp, durable rigid lenses. Gas permeable lenses for demanding prescriptions that want sharp, long-lasting optics. Learn more
Multifocal Contacts Near and far, without the readers. Multifocal contacts for presbyopia, so you can read a menu and see across the room without reaching for readers. Learn more

The difference a fitting makes

A fitting, not a coupon

A big-box value counter hands you a box off the shelf and a two-pairs-and-a-free-exam deal, then sends you on your way. That is a transaction. A real fitting measures your cornea, checks your tear film, and watches how a lens actually sits and moves on your eye. That matters, because a lens that is only "close enough" is the one that dries out by mid-afternoon, blurs when you have astigmatism, or never quite settles.

We take the time to get that right the first time, and we are here when something needs adjusting. That is the difference between a lens that is comfortable and healthy and one that is merely close. We compete on the fit and the relationship, not on a coupon.

Why trust the fitting to us

42 years of fitting Clear Lake eyes

The reason a fitting goes faster and more comfortably here is simple: the same doctor has fitted Clear Lake contact lens wearers for 42 years, here since 1984. Dr. Hyder already knows your eyes, your history, and which lenses have worked for you before. That continuity, a face you recognize and a chart that remembers, is something a rotating chain counter can't offer. We won't quote you a comfort number. We'll just remember what fit.

Insurance and next steps

Start or renew your contact lens fitting

Book an eye exam to start or renew your fitting, or call and talk to a real person who can find you a time. We accept most major vision and medical plans, and we will help you figure out what applies to you.

Plans we accept include:

VSP EyeMed Superior Vision Aetna Blue Cross Blue Shield Cigna Medicare Tricare

Coverage varies by plan, so call (281) 488-0066 and we will walk you through what yours covers, including pricing.

Already have a current prescription?

If your fitting is current, you don't need another exam to restock. Call the front desk and we'll sort your next supply out with you, from a doctor who actually knows your eyes.
